key_points_correct: Thorough SPIFFE/SPIRE design with SVID-based cross-environment federation
Covers IRSA for AWS, Managed Identities for Azure, on-prem PKI
PrivateLink endpoints use for_each with toset correctly
Good comparison table with routing changes per option
key_points_missing: aws_transit_gateway resource uses non-existent vpc_id parameter
No private subnets defined (zero-trust requires no public subnets)
VPN connection to Transit Gateway not configured
brief_justification: Identity design is excellent with SPIFFE/SPIRE federation. The HCL has incorrect TGW resource type and missing private subnet configuration, which are significant gaps in the networking foundation.
